closure_reason: Independent exact physical-image assessment found that the raw-channel two-state span retained only 2.706% of the initial squared response norm. Preserve its valid physical scope result, but do not repeat this metric for chemical accuracy or increase its bond cap to rescue it.
purpose: First coupled polarised-basis molecular use of the physical tensor backend, beyond a single global Fock vector on this GPU
input: One bounded CUDA RHF input using GPU integrals with CPU integral entry points blocked; no native GPU4PySCF XC wrapper
method: One literal Hamiltonian response to the paired determinant, complete-spin-multiplet compression, then exact two-state nonorthogonal Rayleigh-Ritz; retain the input determinant
constant_shift: Subtract E_HF/N from the one-body diagonal, exactly H-E_HF in the fixed-N physical sector; restore the constant in reported energies
scope: Physical state/action and larger-basis scope diagnostic only, not a converged density functional, chemical-accuracy, learned-transfer or WTMAD-2 test
acceptance: Literal energy identity, number/spin, norm, Hermiticity and input retention. Full physical residual and reference energy remain unmeasured; do not claim an accuracy pass from variational lowering or local compression indicators.
resource_bound: One CUDA job, one host orchestration core, at most 1 GB new disk, existing 40 GB total budget
